Context: A. Fixation of Pay on deputation

| Pay in Level 11 at a stage equal to or next higher | 96,600 |
| NOTE.- DA and HRA admissible on ex cadre pay. | |
| (b) If he opts to draw deputation allowance. Pay in Level 10 | 92,700 |
| Deputation allowance at 5% of pav t 4,635 limited to ~ 4,500 | 4,500 |  
NoTE. DA and HRA not admissible on deputation allowance. Hence in this case opting for cadre pay will be more beneficial.
